title: Trade-In Appraisal, Negative Equity and Lien Payoff — Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Trade-in terms of the Vehicle Purchase Agreements.**

**Appraisal validity.** A trade-in appraisal is honored only when the buyer's order is signed no later than the deal type's appraisal validity days after the appraisal date. Calendar days are added to the appraisal date, which is day 0. Signing on the last day is still within validity. The evidence is the appraisal date on the deal's record.

**Mileage.** The appraisal also lapses once the trade-in has been driven more than the deal type's mileage tolerance beyond the appraisal odometer. A lapsed appraisal is redone before the allowance is written.

**Negative equity.** Negative equity is the trade payoff amount less the trade-in allowance, when that difference is above 0.00. It is posted on the contract date. It is payable within the deal type's negative-equity days after delivery, unless it is included in the amount financed.

**Lien payoff.** The store pays off the trade-in lien within the deal type's payoff period in business days after delivery (Monday to Friday, excluding US federal holidays). Where the deal type provides for reimbursement, the store reimburses late charges the trade lender assesses because of a later payoff.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical deal type with a 7-day validity, appraisal on the 11th of a month)

| Buyer's order signed | Appraisal honored |
|---|---|
| the 18th (appraisal date plus 7) | yes: signing on the last day is within validity |
| the 19th | no |

## Negative equity (hypothetical)

| Payoff | Allowance | Negative equity posted |
|---|---|---|
| 14250.00 | 11900.00 | 2350.00 |
| 9000.00 | 9600.00 | none (the difference is not above 0.00) |
